items.headline: Javion Kinnard's 2 rushing TDs help San Diego State beat Washington State 26-20
items.description: — Javion Kinnard had 87 yards rushing and two touchdowns, wide receiver Bert Emanuel Jr. threw a 2-yard touchdown pass to Jackson Ford, and San Diego State beat Washington State 26-20 on Saturday night.

items.description: Washington State (1-7) at San Diego State (3-5), Oct. 31 at 7 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Hauss Hejny's 5 total touchdowns power Colorado State in 56-49 win over San Diego State
items.description: — Hauss Hejny accounted for five touchdowns — three passing and two rushing — and Colorado State snapped a four-game losing streak, holding off San Diego State 56-49 on Saturday night.
